correctness.rationale: For 16 Bernoulli weighted vertices, each 5-set normalized simplex determinant is integer. Vanishing at each p_i=0,1 factors e4=∏p_i(1-p_i); degree at most 5 per bias, reflection p_i↦1-p_i and coordinate permutations force the quotient to be symmetric multiaffine in q_i and hence Σa_j e_j(q). An independently implemented exhaustive census of all 4368 five-sets found determinant multiplicities 1360/2672/320/16 for 0/1/2/3 and exactly the claimed 13 nonzero diagonal coefficient counts. This determines R=1-4e3+18e4 on all biases, rather than extrapolating a finite sample. Separate exact rational summation at biases (1/2,1/3,1/4,1/5) gave ratio 1613/1800. Because 4Σ1/q_i-18≥46, the deficit is ≥46e4² with sharp equality at all q_i=1/4. Only the product-distribution subfamily, not all 16 weights, is proved.
